title: Pet Grooming Marketing Agency | More Bookings | TailWerks

facts.fact: TailWerks lists Essentials at $297 per month per location, and it can run on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth.
facts.quote: Essentials can run on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth for $297/month per location.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that Essentials' service scope is included in the private Scale quote and that there is no separate Essentials management fee.
facts.quote: Its service scope is included in the private Scale quote, with no separate Essentials management fee.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that usage and applicable third-party charges for Essentials remain separate from its management fee.
facts.quote: Usage and applicable third-party charges remain separate.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that Scale is available to established Growth clients after six months on Growth.
facts.quote: Scale, after six months on Growth

facts.fact: TailWerks lists its search advertising for groomers service as available from the Foundation package and up.
TailWerks lists its local SEO and grooming website service as available from the Foundation package and up.
facts.quote: Local SEO and a clearer grooming website

facts.fact: TailWerks lists its managed social media service as available from the Growth package and up.
TailWerks states that the missed-call follow-up service is available as Essentials and is included in Scale.
TailWerks states that Local Services Ads management applies only where the grooming business is eligible.
facts.quote: Local Services Ads management applies where your business is eligible.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that final deliverables for its grooming marketing packages are agreed in writing.
facts.quote: Final deliverables are agreed in writing.
